== Summary ==
"SWCCG Worlds 2008 Day #2 Bye" card awarded at the 2008 Yavin IV Regional, made out to [[Brad Eier]]. The card gave him a bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]], where he played Day 2.

* '''Source:''' [https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/2627547125/ "day2bye"], flickr, posted by brad227lex on 1 July 2008. flickr caption: "this is the card i got at yavin telling me i have my worlds day 2 bye"
* '''Original image:''' https://live.staticflickr.com/3112/2627547125_b8abb447b4_o.jpg (3264×2448, Kodak EasyShare M883)
* '''Date:''' photographed 28 May 2008 (camera time 16:58), so the Yavin IV Regional was on or before that date
* '''Photographer:''' [[Brad Eier]] (flickr user ''brad227lex''), chairperson of the [[2008 US East Nationals]]. The account is his: its bye-card photo is captioned "this is the card i got at yavin" and the card bears the handwritten name Brad Eier (see [[:File:2008 Worlds Day 2 bye card Yavin IV Regional Brad Eier.jpg]]), and the sealed-deck caption says "we ran" the side event.
* '''Licence:''' flickr lists the photo as All Rights Reserved. Uploaded as a record of the tournament with the wiki owner's approval; credit the photographer and link the flickr page when reusing.
* '''Identification:''' Handwritten name on the card reads "Brad Eier"; the photographer (brad227lex) says it is his card. A second shot of the same card is [https://www.flickr.com/photos/28182354@N06/2628343358/ 2628343358] ("another photo of the bye card from yavin that people wanted to see").
